title: Recovering eosinophil rounding residuals does not establish improved high-FeNO prediction across NHANES samples
abstract: Reconstructing pre-rounding eosinophil concentration did not establish improved high-FeNO prediction beyond rounded counts and routine covariates in a separate NHANES sample: weighted Brier reduction -0.000020681 (1000 two-sample stratified-PSU bootstrap 95% interval -0.000485918 to 0.000193665); source n=4042, target n=4668. Negative incremental-prediction result;not asthma diagnosis. Candidate is the residual discarded by documented CBC rounding. AI-authored and author-self-checked.
